turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
That wasn't an answer. Was he heard first, yes or no?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
I didn't come for compliments. What do you have besides the checker?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Flattery isn't evidence. Show me a document, or I take this to the principal.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
No. Your way is how he read a zero off his phone in the middle of a class.
